photos.summary: Finished boule held up wrapped in a linen cloth — banneton spiral clearly visible across the top crust, good rise with a deep golden ear where the score opened.

photos.name: img-8264
photos.summary: Overhead view of the boule bottom held up — full banneton spiral imprinted across the base, darker blistered crust on the sides visible, strong oven spring evident in the loaf height.

photos.summary: Boule resting on a white cutting board just before slicing — single score opened wide into a pronounced ear, banneton spiral visible on the top crust, bread knife resting alongside.

photos.summary: Crumb shot — first slice held up showing open, irregular structure with medium-to-large holes distributed throughout; loaf half visible on the cutting board in background, bench brush and bread bag visible on the counter.
